items.detail: The Cultural Center presents an afternoon of poetry, conversation and inspiration. Join us to share what you have been working on with others and enjoy what it feels like to be heard. Light Snacks and fall beverages will be provided!
items.title: Poetry Open Mic

items.detail: The Harper College Community Music Center presents THE FESTIVAL CHORUS CHRISTMAS CONCERT 2026 at the Harper College Performing Arts Center. Experiemce the joyful harmony of 80 choral voices accompanied by a professional orchestra conducted by Gregory Tipps and Sarah Inendino. The pieces performed will include Celebrate the Season by Joel Raney, All Praise to Thee by Hagenbuerg, Angel band by Kirchner and The Brightest & Best by Kirchner. For tickets go to harpercollege.edu/boxoffice or call 847.925-6100. Ticket cost $20 Gen Admission, $15 Seniors, students, Harper faculty/staff. Children under 12 are FREE.
items.title: The Festival Chorus Christmas Concert 2026

items.detail: Join us for a dual celebration of student talent at the Harper Graphic Arts Design & Technology Portfolio Show and Photo Showcase. This combined event highlights the capstone work of Graphic Arts Design & Technology students alongside striking imagery from Graphic Arts Photography students and members of the Harper Photo Club. Explore a rich variety of graphic design, digital media, and photography representing creative dedication and technical expertise. Date: December 9th Time: 6:30 PM – 8:30 PM Location: Avanté Corridor
items.title: Graphic Arts Design & Technology - Fall Portfolio Show & Photo Showcase
